subject: Bayesian Mixer Meetup, 12 February, London, UK

messages.author: bee80b3759bcfc8a
messages.subject: Bayesian Mixer Meetup, 12 February, London, UK
parts:
Hi all,

There is a nice pub between Bunhill Fields and the Royal Statistical Society in London: The Artillery Arms. Clearly, the perfect place to bring people together to talk about Bayesian Statistics. Well, that’s what my friend Jon (http://applied.ai) and I thought.

Hence, we’d like to organise a Bayesian Mixer Meetup there on Friday, 12 February, 19:00. We booked the upstairs function room. Actually, you can see Thomas Bayes’ grave from there.

Jon is more the Python/PyMC guy, while I come from the R/Rstan corner. We both started to embrace Bayesian models recently and would like to get to know others to share ideas, pains and experiences and to learn from each other. Jon and I will prepare two talks to kick this off.

If you would like to join us, please get in touch, so that we can keep tabs on numbers. We hope that between 10 to 20 people will rock up.

—
Markus Gesmann
Blog: www.magesblog.com
